title: Record a change that holds a relayed decision at workflow version 3 so released SpecSync 6.2.0 refuses it instead of dropping relayed_by
description: Record a change that holds a relayed decision at workflow version 3 so released SpecSync 6.2.0 refuses it instead of dropping relayed_by
acceptance_criteria: A change that holds a relayed approval, review or correction is recorded at workflow version 3 (origin 2, every digest unchanged), so the real SpecSync 6.2.0 release binary refuses it with 'was written by a newer SpecSync (workflow version 3); upgrade specsync to read it' and changes nothing, as REQ-change-158 states

answers.constraints: specs/change/change.3md z=34 (compare a record the way its digest reads it: the version raise is outside every digest, so every currency, integrity and succession comparison reads version 3 as 2) and z=31 (an old binary that cannot parse a record refuses the repository's change lifecycle; here that refusal is the point)
